meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 将 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮箱:复制并注册 Resend 适配器、安装固定版本的依赖、引导填写 API 密钥和发件信息、自动配置 webhook、把你设为所有者并发送欢迎邮件,之后即可通过邮件与机器人异步对话。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮箱或添加邮件渠道时触发,常见于 /setup 流程中。

say.text: 帮我接入 Resend 邮箱
say.note: 技能会开始复制和注册 Resend 适配器。

say.text: 添加 Resend 邮件渠道
say.note: 会提示你粘贴 API 密钥等参数。

say.text: 配置邮箱,把我也设为所有者
say.note: 设置好后会给你的邮箱发欢迎邮件。

howto.what_en: Connects NanoClaw to email via Resend: copies and registers the Resend adapter, installs a pinned dependency, handles API key and sender setup, configures webhook, wires you as owner, and sends a welcome email — enabling async email conversations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Resend/email channel, including during /setup.

say_en.text: Set me up with Resend email
say_en.note: It copies and registers the adapter.
Prompts for API key and sender details.

say_en.text: Configure email and make me the owner
say_en.note: Sends a welcome email to your address.
